lessons.title: Idioms: Common English Idioms
lessons.content: Idioms are expressions that have a figurative meaning different from their literal meaning. Learning common idioms helps you understand native English speakers and express yourself more naturally.

details.explanation: A person's occupation, status, or social class. Used in the phrase 'all walks of life' to mean people from many different backgrounds.
details.example: She has friends from all walks of life.
details.burmese: 'walk of life' ဆိုတာ လူတစ်ယောက်ရဲ့ အလုပ်၊ လူမှုအဆင့်အတန်းကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

details.explanation: Something very easy to do. Used to describe tasks that require little effort.
details.example: The exam was a piece of cake.
details.burmese: 'a piece of cake' ဆိုတာ အလွယ်တကူ လုပ်နိုင်တဲ့ အရာကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

details.explanation: A gentle way to ask someone what they are thinking about, especially when they are quiet.
details.example: You have been quiet all morning, a penny for your thoughts?
details.burmese: 'a penny for your thoughts' ဆိုတာ တစ်ယောက်ယောက် ဘာတွေတွေးနေလဲ မေးတဲ့ နည်းလမ်းပါ။

details.explanation: Very happy and smiling. Used to describe someone who is showing great happiness.
details.example: She was all smiles at the news of her win.
details.burmese: 'all smiles' ဆိုတာ ပျော်ပျော်ပန်းပန်း ရှိနေတာကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

details.explanation: A person who is considered a disgrace or failure by their family or group.
details.example: My brother is the black sheep of the family.
details.burmese: 'black sheep' ဆိုတာ မိသားစုရဲ့ စိတ်နှောင့်ရှက်ဖွယ်လူကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

details.explanation: To initiate a conversation or ease tension in a social situation, especially when people are meeting for the first time.
details.example: She sent him a text to break the ice.
details.burmese: 'break the ice' ဆိုတာ ပထမဆုံးတွေ့တဲ့အခါ စကားစပြပြီး ရင်းနှီးအောင်လုပ်တာပါ။

details.explanation: Something very easy to do; something that requires little skill or effort.
details.example: The test was real child's play.
details.burmese: 'child's play' ဆိုတာ အလွန်လွယ်ကူတဲ့ အရာကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

details.explanation: Fake or insincere tears; pretending to be sad when you are not really sad.
details.example: Don't soften your heart; he was shedding crocodile tears.
details.burmese: 'crocodile tears' ဆိုတာ ဟန်ဆောင်ပြီးငိုတာကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

details.explanation: To pay for something; to cover the cost of something.
details.example: Who's going to foot the bill for the damage?
details.burmese: 'foot the bill' ဆိုတာ ကုန်ကျစရိတ်ကို ပေးဆောင်တာပါ။

details.explanation: To remove, throw away, or eliminate something unwanted.
details.example: It is difficult to get rid of insects.
details.burmese: 'get rid of' ဆိုတာ မလိုချင်တဲ့အရာကို ဖယ်ရှားပစ်တာပါ။

details.explanation: To control oneself or a situation; to calm down and behave sensibly.
details.example: Get a grip on yourself!
details.burmese: 'get a grip' ဆိုတာ ကိုယ့်ကိုယ်ကို ထိန်းချုပ်တာပါ။

details.explanation: To become extremely angry or furious about something.
details.example: Mom will go through the roof when she finds out we disobeyed her again.
details.burmese: 'go through the roof' ဆိုတာ အလွန်ဒေါသထွက်တာကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

details.explanation: A polite way to express that something is not possible or to deliver bad news.
details.example: I'm afraid we can't come.
details.burmese: 'I'm afraid' ဆိုတာ စိတ်မကောင်းစွာ ငြင်းဆိုတဲ့ ယဉ်ကျေးတဲ့ ပုံစံပါ။

details.explanation: To stop talking about something; to accept the current situation and not continue further.
details.example: We will never agree, so let's just leave it at that.
details.burmese: 'leave it at that' ဆိုတာ ဒီလောက်ပဲထားလိုက်ကြပါလို့ ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

details.explanation: A polite response to thanks, meaning 'you're welcome'; also means 'not in any way'.
details.example: Thank you for all your help. Not at all.
details.burmese: 'not at all' ဆိုတာ ကျေးဇူးတင်တဲ့အခါ ပြန်ဖြေတဲ့ ယဉ်ကျေးတဲ့ စကားပါ။

details.explanation: Immediately; right away; at that very moment without delay.
details.example: The policeman arrested the thief on the spot.
details.burmese: 'on the spot' ဆိုတာ ချက်ချင်း၊ ချိန်ချိန်ဆဆ ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

details.explanation: Feeling unwell, slightly ill, or not in one's usual good health.
details.example: You look a little off colour today.
details.burmese: 'off colour' ဆိုတာ နမကောင်းဖြစ်နေတာကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

details.explanation: Extremely happy and delighted about something.
details.example: She's over the moon about her new job.
details.burmese: 'over the moon' ဆိုတာ အလွန်ပျော်ရွှင်နေတာကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

details.explanation: Very rarely; almost never; something that happens extremely infrequently.
details.example: I see her once in a blue moon.
details.burmese: 'once in a blue moon' ဆိုတာ အလွန်ရှားရှားဖြစ်ဖြစ် ဖြစ်တာကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

details.explanation: Unexpectedly; without warning; completely surprising.
details.example: His resignation came out of the blue.
details.burmese: 'out of the blue' ဆိုတာ မမျှော်လင့်ဘဲ ဖြစ်လာတာကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

details.explanation: An unrealistic or impossible hope or plan; a dream that is unlikely to come true.
details.example: His dream to become President is just a pie in the sky.
details.burmese: 'pie in the sky' ဆိုတာ မဖြစ်နိုင်တဲ့ မျှော်လင့်ချက်ကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။
